zh-HK: MTD 當月分析新增 Time Gone 指標：顯示已過工作日佔全月比例，並以百分點標示達成率超前或落後進度
統一 Sales History、Section、NB、MTD 及 Customer Report 財務口徑：共用解析並保留完整小數；零金額補發不計成交，退貨不推進最近成交日
修正自訂日期新客報表執行錯誤、產品近 13 個月與 Solution Mix 多計一個月，以及快選「3個月」實際涵蓋 4 個月
en: Monthly MTD analysis now shows a Time Gone indicator: the share of working days elapsed, with the achievement rate flagged as ahead of or behind pace in percentage points

Unified financial parsing across Sales History, Section, NB, MTD and Customer Report, keeping full decimal precision; zero-amount replacements are excluded and credit notes no longer advance the last order date
Fixed a runtime error in the custom-date new customer report, off-by-one month windows in the 13-month product analysis and Solution Mix, and the quick range where 3 months actually covered 4
